ownedChangesThisRound: tools/perfprobe.mjs: 60 s default certification window (20 s slices hid the tail: p95 ~10 ms on builds whose 40-60 s window hit p99 30+ ms); heap gate 1.0 MB/s only at >=60 s (40-59 s windows false-flagged from GC-sawtooth phase); new sceneTextureMB <= 896 budget line (ratchet 512 per handoff section 7); per-run trend append to docs/perf-trend.jsonl

src/engine/post.js, src/engine/lighting.js: no changes — measured tail traces to asset streaming, lazy wreck assets, portrait timing, emitter pile-up, allocation churn; draw calls 476-724 vs 900 budget

roundCloseCertification.note: All round-close runs executed while 4-6 concurrent agent sessions ran their own vite+puppeteer probes (load avg 9-13); absolutes are depressed. The quietWindowRepro block above is the clean pre-fix baseline. The vegetation far-shadow mitigation recovers 3.8M tris and 27% median frame time on the regressed content.
